text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock, drink a glass of water, and eat a healthy breakfast. After that, I start work at nine and stay focused until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break in between. Around six, I go to the gym or take a run in the park, because exercise helps me relax and feel energetic. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a film with my family. I try to follow the same schedule every day, since consistency keeps me healthy, productive, and happy.
